package com.x;
public class BAlt extends BAbstractService {
  @Override
  public final Feature getLicenseFeature() {
    return Sys.getLicenseManager().getFeature("vendor", "feature");
  }
  public void doA() {
    if (isFault()) return;
    a();
  }
  public void doB() {
    if (isFatalFault()) return;
    b();
  }
}
